alerts.title: TEFAP Federal Allocation Reduced 40%
alerts.description: The Emergency Food Assistance Program allocation for Missouri was cut by 40% effective March 1, 2026. Harvesters reports a 3-million-pound shortfall this quarter.

alerts.title: 311 Food Assistance Calls Up 24%
alerts.description: 311 calls related to food assistance have increased 24% in ZIP 64130 and 28% in ZIP 66101 over the past 6 months.

alerts.title: Emergency: 1,000 lbs Fresh Produce — 48hr Spoilage
alerts.description: A local farm donated 1,000 pounds of fresh tomatoes and peppers. Spoils in 48 hours. Needs immediate distribution plan — cold chain, transportation, and targeting to highest-need areas.

alerts.title: Community Vote Required — 2 Priority Zones
alerts.description: City council added a community vote requirement for Zones 2 and 3 (ZIPs 66101, 66105). One zone is 80% Spanish-speaking. Vote deadline: 14 days. Residents must support the initiative — not just organizations.
